capabilities: Track notes or whole folders for spaced repetition review
Review due notes in a queue via a review view
Choose and switch between SRS algorithms (Anki, SM2, Leitner)
Show review status and queue counts in the status bar
extras: Not yet available in the community plugin directory and must be installed manually. Only note headings or file names are used as questions; flashcard-style items are listed as planned features. Switching algorithms requires a plugin reload and can alter existing review intervals.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced repetition system for reviewing notes on a scheduled basis, and existing approaches may lock users into one algorithm.
summary: Spaced repetition plugin that tracks whole notes for review and lets users choose between multiple SRS algorithms (Anki, SM2, Leitner).
